item: Check a file (evidence bundle, image metadata) and server IPs in the source trail (Lane M)
summary: Three server reads that had no button now have one. Evidence & custody tab: one compact Check a file picker verifies a signed evidence bundle (optionally against the signer's key) or shows an image's EXIF, date, camera and decimal GPS (a file declaring over 50 MP is refused before decoding); nothing leaves the machine or is stored. The custody log check stays unwired: its verifier passes an empty or end-truncated log and fails a per-item export. Sources tab: the source trail lists the server IPs a source answered from, counts the ones it could not have (Tor/proxy, not captured), shows the CDN caveat and the DB-IP credit. Feature ceiling 76 to 73.
